items.title: The gesture lane's two hardware judgements

items.title: Lane 3, Cards copy audit
items.body: remains the next queue lane, subject to the live-Drive access check before anything is compared. Lane 22 stays a draft until it has a Solves line. The HQ tier pass folding lanes 24, 25 and 28 into the landed archive is still open.

items.title: The standing live view, one command on the Mac
items.body: the workbench piece is built and committed (Projects/Design System/standing-view.cjs plus standing-view-setup.sh), and installs only when Mark runs bash "Projects/Design System/standing-view-setup.sh". It writes the login item, loads it, and prints as the Mac-only link. All three workbench decisions were ruled A and are settled below.

items.title: One Penpot file with the MCP plugin open (28 September)
items.body: the Penpot AI Kit is installed end to end on Mark's rulings, quoted "Install for OpenCode, remote", "On demand as skills" and "Key saved to a file". The penpot MCP entry is live and verified, the key is in the config and its Desktop copy is deleted. The only thing left is his hands: open a Penpot file, launch the MCP plugin from its Plugins panel, and leave that tab open while a session works. Detail: W40 _notes/session-2026-09-28-penpot-ai-kit-install.md.

items.title: From W39, unchanged
items.body: the COMMAND grant in the Arena app's repository list; the planner's task list and due dates as proposed or amended; the 9 trainer card fact checks and titles; three on the copy workbench (the 82-line corpus, the copywriter-trainer.html filename, who reads first); the URL law's format; the two lane 23 brief corrections; the Flower studio one-click save and title-variant swap; the voice-dictation grants and vocabulary; the Arena one-time sign-in; the WHEEL circle hit target; whether state.json is ever promoted to own live task state; parked: gesture-home placement, the iOS Safari look, and the W37 phone test. Open People stays parked on Mark's word.

items.title: Go Plus from 1 October (his hands)
items.body: Mark, 30 September, quoted: "I'll likely try Go Plus from the 1st". The purchase lives in the OpenCode console billing. Plan comparison, measured burn and the recommendation: W40 _notes/session-2026-09-30-opencode-plan-research.md.

items.title: OmO provider login (his hands)
items.body: OmO 5.1.5 installed at ~/.local/bin/omo, Penpot MCP carried across, auth.json cleaned to a single default account pinned to opencode-go, and the model is picked: opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-pro has held the session seat since 30 September (kimi-k3 was the boot default). Detail: W40 _notes/session-2026-09-30-omo-login.md.

items.title: Core HQ's Model Ladder panel, once
items.body: The panel is written into Operations/Artifacts/Core-HQ.html, but the standing Core HQ link is a published copy that nothing in the system can republish any more, so the strip reaches that link only through a hand republish or the Arena-scoped Core HQ rebuild, which is already an open question. The Model Ladder page itself is live and standing at and needs nothing from him.

items.title: Arena sign-in, once (24 September)
items.body: The automation browser at arena.ai/agent has no session, so pipeline Stage 1's Arena path is manual until he signs in and clicks Connect on the GitHub bar once. The Playwright profile persists, so it is one grant, per his requirement, quoted: "I only want to grant access once and not have to keep stepping in." Local lanes are unaffected and running.
